tasks.short: Design and conduct applied biofuels research

steps.what: Open the biofuels research project topics
Conduct fermentation, distillation, and separation runs

tasks.design: Project topics such as transport, mixing, filtration, extraction, fermentation, distillation, and separation are opened from {PROJECT}. The manager designs the applied biodiesel research and conducts the runs. A topic on the list is not a result.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan lived in a notebook, and the run notes were separate from the project.
tasks.enabler_now: The topic list is on the project, so the design starts from named questions.
tasks.still_hard: The design and the bench work stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager designs the research and conducts it.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the topics before designing a run.

evidence.claim: A topic list can be opened, and the design and the runs stay with the manager. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a biofuels research project is set up and ends when the manager has conducted the planned runs or noted what was not run.
A topic has project id and name, written by the manager. The system does not add a topic.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Which of the named topics this lab can actually run.
research_questions: Which topics have no run notes?

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a topic list that already exists. Design and the experimental runs stay with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open water treatments and solvent extraction studies
Total stored biofuels extraction and recovery figures
Analyze fluid behaviour and the recovery processes

tasks.design: Study tables for water treatments, solvent extraction, and recovery are opened from {DATA_PLATFORM}. Totals are the stored figures added up. The manager analyzes what they mean. The totals do not explain the fluid behaviour. A blank cell is not filled.
tasks.previous_blocker: The totals were rebuilt in a side sheet for each study.
tasks.enabler_now: The measurements are stored, so the totals do not need a side sheet.
tasks.still_hard: What the totals mean for the process stays with the manager.

ambition.what: A study with stored measurements shows its totals the day they are entered, and the manager still analyzes them.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the totals before the analysis.

evidence.claim: Totals come from stored measurements, and the scientific analysis stays with the manager. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a biofuels study has measurements and ends when the manager has written the analysis.
A row has study id, measure, and value, entered from the bench. A missing value is left out of the total.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the bench records are entered as values rather than as scans.
research_questions: Which studies have measurements that were not totaled?

already_counted.description: The bench or review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts studies whose measurements are already stored. Interpreting the fluid behaviour and the process stays with the manager.

steps.what: Open the biofuels research and development brief
Prepare experimental plans from the brief
Oversee preparation that the plan left open

tasks.design: The research and development brief is opened from {DOCS}. The manager prepares the experimental plan and oversees preparation that is still open. The brief does not become a plan on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan was rewritten from the last project, and open items were easy to miss.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief is stored on the project, so the plan starts from it.
tasks.still_hard: What the experiment should do, and whether preparation is enough, stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager prepares the plan and oversees it.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the brief before the plan is used.

reach.learn: Which plan items are still open.

evidence.claim: A brief can be opened, and the plan and the oversight stay with the manager. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an experiment needs a plan and ends when the manager has prepared it and noted what is still open.
The brief has project id and questions, written by the manager. The system does not add a step to the plan.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether every question in the brief can be run in this lab.
research_questions: Which plan items are still open?

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a brief that already exists. Preparing and overseeing the plan stay with the manager.

tasks.short: Provide scientific guidance to technical staff

steps.what: Provide technical and scientific guidance to staff
Note conduct of the development the guidance missed

tasks.design: The research or development protocol is opened from {DOCS}. The manager provides technical and scientific guidance in person. The note records the protocol point, not a score of a staff member. Nobody is ranked.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guidance was given from memory, and the protocol version was not always the one on the bench.
tasks.enabler_now: The protocol is stored, so the conversation starts from the current version.
tasks.still_hard: The guidance itself stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides what guidance the work needs.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the protocol before guiding staff, and nobody is scored.

evidence.claim: A protocol can be opened, and the guidance stays with the manager, with no score. The source pack says a report is drafted from stored records and a person signs, and that a draft stops when a cited item is missing. Laboratory work and the scientific judgement stay with the person.

The source pack says hiring, evaluation, and monitoring of staff must not be decided by automation alone, and need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score staff. A report or a proposal is signed by the manager before it goes out. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when technical staff are conducting the research and ends when the manager has given the guidance.
The protocol has protocol id and steps, written by the manager. The note does not contain a score.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing result, mass, or finding is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether staff may see the protocol version used in the note.
research_questions: Which protocol steps have not been walked through?

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening the current protocol. The guidance stays with the manager, and no staff member is scored.
